test_binary_match_return_true: test the PCAttestationService binary_match method to verify it returns true when measurements match
test_binary_match_false_value: test the PCAttestationService binary_match method to verify it returns false when measurement values differ
test_binary_match_not_found_key: test the PCAttestationService binary_match method to verify it returns false when measurement keys are missing
test_validate_binary_match_policy: test the PCAttestationService validate method with a BINARY_MATCH policy and matching measurements
test_validate_invalid_params: test the PCAttestationService validate method to verify it raises InvalidParameterError for null params
